async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Locate the search box and button from the complementary section
    search_box = page.get_by_role("complementary").get_by_role("search").get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    search_button = page.get_by_role("complementary").get_by_role("search").get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    
    # Fill the search box with 'GPT'
    await search_box.fill("GPT")
    
    # Click the search button
    await search_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the page to load after search
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait to ensure results are rendered
    
    # Click on the third search result
    all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
    link_count = await all_links.count()
    if link_count >= 3:
        third_link = all_links.nth(2)  # Zero-indexed, so nth(2) is the third link
        await third_link.click()
    else:
        raise Exception("Less than 3 search results found.")

async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Locate the search box and button from the complementary section
    search_box = page.get_by_role("complementary").get_by_role("search").get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    search_button = page.get_by_role("complementary").get_by_role("search").get_by_role("button", name="Search")

    # Fill the search box with 'GPT'
    await search_box.fill("GPT")

    # Click the search button
    await search_button.click()

    # Wait for the page to load after search
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait to ensure results are rendered

    # Click on the third search result
    all_links = page.get_by_role("link")
    link_count = await all_links.count()
    if link_count >= 3:
        third_link = all_links.nth(2)  # Zero-indexed, so nth(2) is the third link
        await third_link.click()
    else:
        raise Exception("Less than 3 search results found.")
    return link_count
